title: FY27 Blanket Purchase Order for Various Flooring Materials
agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
agency_path: City of New York > Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
description_text: This contract will be used to purchase supplies used in the repair and maintenance of floor coverings and surfaces at HRA locations, citywide, with particular attention to those materials not otherwise available through existing DCAS requirement contracts. Examples of such items can be tiles, paste, grout, carpeting, and safety equipment. The period of service is 7/1/2026-6/30/2027.
